procedural_matters: Cases 22 and 27 where heared together since the arrised from the same incident
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Kohei Zchlkawa, coach of JPN, acted as a translator for him during the hearing.
Genki Kahara, helm of JPN, represented her in the hearing
Emmanouil Anastasios Vomvylas, was a called a a witness to the hearing and gave evidence
facts: On the first downwind leg of the 6th race, GRE became stuck with the port side mark of the leeward gate, dragging it several meters to leeward.
As a result of this, JPN who was behind GRE before the rounding went from appx. 15th to 30th place in the race.
There was no injury nor physical damage to JPN.
GRE did not take a penalty regarding this incident, was not penalized and finished the race.
conclusions: JPN did not endure injury nor physical damage from the incident. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(2) are not met.
